items.title: Understanding the brain with AI-driven explanations and experiments
items.content:

items.title: Talos: Scaling rare disease diagnosis with automated, iterative genomic reanalysis
items.content:
Talos was built to help resolve a major bottleneck in genomic medicine: human review time. The open-source system recovered 90% of in-scope diagnoses while surfacing just 1.3 candidate variants per patient for expert review.

The post Talos: Scaling rare disease diagnosis with automated, iterative genomic reanalysis appeared first on Microsoft Research.

items.title: Ire identifies another LOTUSLITE specimen
items.content:
Project Ire examined a timely malware sample and determined its intent through reverse engineering—identifying LOTUSLITE characteristics even as most major EDR tools did not detect it.

The post Ire identifies another LOTUSLITE specimen appeared first on Microsoft Research.

items.title: Data Formulator 0.7: AI-powered data analytics for enterprise data
items.content:
Data Formulator introduces AI-powered analytics for enterprise data workflows. Data teams can easily bring enterprise data into an AI-ready workspace where users can explore, analyze, and visualize data with AI agents to turn raw data into actionable insights.

The post Data Formulator 0.7: AI-powered data analytics for enterprise data appeared first on Microsoft Research.

summaries.zh: Data Formulator 0.7 是一款企业级数据分析工具，采用人工智能技术。它允许数据团队将企业数据导入AI工作空间，通过AI代理进行数据探索、分析和可视化，从而将原始数据转化为可操作的洞察。该工具由微软研究院开发。
summaries.en: Data Formulator 0.7 is an AI-powered analytics tool designed for enterprise data workflows. It enables data teams to integrate enterprise data into an AI-ready workspace, where users can explore, analyze, and visualize data with AI agents. The platform transforms raw data into actionable insights, enhancing data-driven decision-making for businesses. The tool was developed by Microsoft Research.

items.title: Extending Human Intelligence Through AI
items.content:
Understanding AI as an extension of human intelligence—not a replacement for it—offers a more grounded path for building trustworthy AI systems.

The post Extending Human Intelligence Through AI appeared first on Microsoft Research.
items.contentSnippet:
Understanding AI as an extension of human intelligence—not a replacement for it—offers a more grounded path for building trustworthy AI systems.
The post Extending Human Intelligence Through AI appeared first on Microsoft Research.
items.creator: Ken Archer, Harald Wiltsche

summaries.zh: 本文强调将人工智能视为人类智能的延伸而非替代，这一观点有助于构建更值得信赖的AI系统。文章指出，理解AI与人类智能的共生关系，能为AI发展提供更稳健的基础。该文首发于微软研究院。
summaries.en: The article discusses AI as an extension of human intelligence rather than a replacement, suggesting this approach fosters more trustworthy AI systems. This perspective, from Microsoft Research, emphasizes integrating AI to augment human capabilities, promoting reliability and ethical development.

items.title: MagenticLite, MagenticBrain, Fara1.5: An agentic experience optimized for small models
items.content:

items.title: Vega: Zero-knowledge proofs for digital identity in the age of AI
items.content:
Vega turns a full credential into a single proof, sharing only what is needed and nothing more, with performance that works in real apps.

The post Vega: Zero-knowledge proofs for digital identity in the age of AI appeared first on Microsoft Research.
items.contentSnippet:
Vega turns a full credential into a single proof, sharing only what is needed and nothing more, with performance that works in real apps. 
The post Vega: Zero-knowledge proofs for digital identity in the age of AI appeared first on Microsoft Research.
items.creator: Srinath Setty

summaries.zh: 维加技术通过零知识证明，将完整凭证转化为单一证明，仅共享必要信息，不泄露额外内容，且在真实应用中表现良好。该技术适用于人工智能时代数字身份管理，确保隐私安全。
summaries.en: Vega is a system that uses zero-knowledge proofs to enhance digital identity security in the age of AI. It converts full credentials into single proofs, enabling selective sharing of information without revealing unnecessary details. Vega offers performance suitable for real-world applications, ensuring efficient and secure identity verification. The technology is presented by Microsoft Research.

items.title: mimalloc: A new, high-performance, scalable memory allocator for the modern era
items.content:
mimalloc is an open-source, modern, scalable memory allocator that is a drop-in replacement for malloc and free. It is relatively small (~12K lines), with clear internal data structures, and is easy to build and integrate into other projects. It provides bounded worst-case allocation times (up to OS primitives), bounded space overhead, low internal fragmentation, and minimal contention by relying almost exclusively on atomic operations.

The post mimalloc: A new, high-performance, scalable memory allocator for the modern era appeared first on Microsoft Research.

It provides bounded worst-case allocation times (up to OS primitives), bounded space overhead, low internal fragmentation, and minimal contention by relying almost exclusively on atomic operations.
The post mimalloc: A new, high-performance, scalable memory allocator for the modern era appeared first on Microsoft Research.

summaries.en: mimalloc is an open-source, high-performance, scalable memory allocator designed as a drop-in replacement for malloc and free. It features a small codebase (~12K lines), clear internal structures, and ease of integration. Key features include bounded worst-case allocation times, minimal space overhead, low internal fragmentation, and reduced contention, achieved through atomic operations. The allocator is modern and suitable for contemporary systems.

items.title: GridSFM: A new, small foundation model for the electric grid
items.content:
Introducing GridSFM, a small foundation model that can predict AC optimal power flow in milliseconds, boosting efficiency and unlocking cost savings. Learn how GridSFM gives grid operators direct visibility into congestion, stability, and system health.

The post GridSFM: A new, small foundation model for the electric grid appeared first on Microsoft Research.
items.contentSnippet:
Introducing GridSFM, a small foundation model that can predict AC optimal power flow in milliseconds, boosting efficiency and unlocking cost savings. Learn how GridSFM gives grid operators direct visibility into congestion, stability, and system health.

items.creator: Weiwei Yang, Andrea Britto Mattos Lima, Thiago Vallin Spina, Spencer Fowers, Baosen   Zhang

summaries.zh: GridSFM是一款新型小型基础模型，可在毫秒内预测交流最优潮流，提升电网效率并实现成本节约。该模型为电网运营商提供直接的可视化能力，帮助其监测拥堵、稳定性和系统健康状况。此技术由微软研究院开发。
summaries.en: GridSFM is a new, small foundation model designed to predict AC optimal power flow in milliseconds, enhancing grid efficiency and enabling cost savings. It provides grid operators with direct insights into congestion, stability, and system health. The model, developed by Microsoft Research, aims to improve electric grid management through rapid and accurate predictions.
